items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: "And Ben Webster, Lady Webster." He said, "They're good players," he said, "but they don't fit."

ctx.x: -- for himself. He said, "Give him the same thing." He ordered me some. He was very sensitive. So I says, "Okay." I ate red beans and rice, too. So then he says to me, he says, "Have you been listening? Have you been keeping up on your instrument?" So I says, " Well, I've been trying," and I says, "I've been listening." I says, "Oh, yeah, I listen all the time," and I says, "I've been trying." He says, "Well," he says, "if you playing anyway like you were the last time I heard you," he said, "it will be your…
playing like you did the last time I heard you, it'll be your engagement."
